name: changelog
description: Keep each project's progress record as a reverse-chronological CHANGELOG.html page instead of a status message that scrolls away. Every entry has a one-line title, a two-sentence subtitle, written and updated timestamps, and Task, Achieved and Remaining as short bullets told twice: a plain version for anyone and a technical version with the PR, the counts and the command that proved it, behind a Plain / Technical switch, laid out as three columns on desktop. Small progress updates the newest entry rather than adding a near-duplicate. Diagrams come from visualization:visualization. A bundled checker fails the page on structural defects (17 of 17 self-test rules fire), and the page is shown by reloading its open Chrome tab rather than stacking duplicates. Replaces status-update for reporting.
